fields.Name: IT66 - Application Behavioral (fan-out and slugs)
fields.Description: Domain 12 S-series Application behavioral invariants (server transport, mutation tier): AB1 DefaultForNewUser fan-out (create-with-true + false-to-true flip each cover every active user exactly once, repeat saves never duplicate); AB2 AutoUpdatePath slug collision walk (-2, -3); AB3 per-application Application Entities Sequence duplicate sweep (the #3027 collision class; contiguity reported). S3's new-user leg is auth-time (unreachable headless); S5 InstallApplication belongs to open-app-teardown. 3 checks AB1-AB3, self-cleaning throwaway apps.
